type mapping

// require raylib                  every function, struct and enum below
// require raylib/raylib_boost     also the color constants and the enum overloads

Vector2, Vector3, Vector4   -> float2, float3, float4
Quaternion                  -> float4
Rectangle                   -> float4       // x, y, width, height
Color (by value)            -> float4       // RGBA in 0..1, converted to bytes for you
Matrix (by value)           -> float4x4     // converted for you
Color, Matrix (in pointers and struct fields) stay raw: use the converters
const char *                -> string
T *                         -> T?

// float4 is both Color and Rectangle: the parameter name tells you which.
// Enum parameters are plain int unless a raylib_boost overload is listed.

// Window and Graphics Device Functions

def CloseWindow()                                          // Close window and unload OpenGL context
def WindowShouldClose() : bool                             // Check if application should close (KEY_ESCAPE pressed or windows close icon clicked)
def IsWindowReady() : bool                                 // Check if window has been initialized successfully
def IsWindowFullscreen() : bool                            // Check if window is currently fullscreen
def IsWindowHidden() : bool                                // Check if window is currently hidden
def IsWindowMinimized() : bool                             // Check if window is currently minimized
def IsWindowMaximized() : bool                             // Check if window is currently maximized
def IsWindowFocused() : bool                               // Check if window is currently focused
def IsWindowResized() : bool                               // Check if window has been resized last frame
def IsWindowState(flag : uint) : bool                      // Check if one specific window flag is enabled

def GetMonitorWidth(monitor : int) : int                   // Get specified monitor width (current video mode used by monitor)
def GetMonitorHeight(monitor : int) : int                  // Get specified monitor height (current video mode used by monitor)
def GetMonitorPhysicalWidth(monitor : int) : int           // Get specified monitor physical width in millimetres
def GetMonitorPhysicalHeight(monitor : int) : int          // Get specified monitor physical height in millimetres

def GetWindowPosition() : float2                           // Get window position XY on monitor
def GetWindowScaleDPI() : float2                           // Get window scale DPI factor
def GetMonitorName(monitor : int) : string                 // Get the human-readable, UTF-8 encoded name of the specified monitor
def SetClipboardText(text : string)                        // Set clipboard text content
def GetClipboardText() : string                            // Get clipboard text content
def GetClipboardImage() : Image                            // Get clipboard image content
def EnableEventWaiting()                                   // Enable waiting for events on EndDrawing(), no automatic event polling
def DisableEventWaiting()                                  // Disable waiting for events on EndDrawing(), automatic events polling

def BeginDrawing()                                                 // Begin canvas (framebuffer) drawing
def EndDrawing()                                                   // End canvas (framebuffer) drawing and swap buffers (double buffering)

def EndMode2D()                                                    // End 2D mode with custom camera

def EndVrStereoMode()                                              // End stereo rendering (requires VR simulator)

def UnloadVrStereoConfig(config : VrStereoConfig)               // Unload VR stereo config

// NOTE: Shader functionality is not available on OpenGL 1.1

def LoadShaderFromMemory(vsCode : string; fsCode : string) : Shader        // Load shader from code strings and bind default locations

def GetShaderLocation(shader : Shader; uniformName : string) : int         // Get shader uniform location
def GetShaderLocationAttrib(shader : Shader; attribName : string) : int    // Get shader attribute location
def SetShaderValue(shader : Shader; locIndex : int; value : void?; uniformType : int)  // Set shader uniform value
def SetShaderValueV(shader : Shader; locIndex : int; value : void?; uniformType : int; count : int)  // Set shader uniform value vector

def SetShaderValueTexture(shader : Shader; locIndex : int; texture : Texture)  // Set shader uniform value and bind the texture (sampler2d)
def UnloadShader(shader : Shader)                                          // Unload shader from GPU memory (VRAM)

// Screen-space-related functions
def GetScreenToWorldRay(position : float2; camera : Camera3D) : Ray    // Get a ray trace from screen position (i.e mouse)
def GetScreenToWorldRayEx(position : float2; camera : Camera3D; width : int; height : int) : Ray  // Get a ray trace from screen position (i.e mouse) in a viewport
def GetWorldToScreen(position : float3; camera : Camera3D) : float2    // Get screen space position for a 3d world space position
def GetWorldToScreenEx(position : float3; camera : Camera3D; width : int; height : int) : float2  // Get sized screen space position for a 3d world space position
def GetWorldToScreen2D(position : float2; camera : Camera2D) : float2  // Get screen space position for a 2d camera world space position
def GetScreenToWorld2D(position : float2; camera : Camera2D) : float2  // Get world space position for a 2d camera screen space position
def GetCameraMatrix(camera : Camera3D) : float4x4                      // Get camera transform matrix (view matrix)
def GetCameraMatrix2D(camera : Camera2D) : float4x4                    // Get camera 2d transform matrix

// Timing-related functions
def SetTargetFPS(fps : int)  // Set target FPS (maximum)
def GetFrameTime() : float   // Get time in seconds for last frame drawn (delta time)
def GetTime() : double       // Get elapsed time in seconds since InitWindow()
def GetFPS() : int           // Get current FPS

// Custom frame control functions
// NOTE: Those functions are intended for advanced users that want full control over the frame processing
// By default EndDrawing() does this job: draws everything + SwapScreenBuffer() + manage frame timing + PollInputEvents()
// To avoid that behaviour and control frame processes manually, enable in config.h: SUPPORT_CUSTOM_FRAME_CONTROL
def SwapScreenBuffer()          // Swap back buffer with front buffer (screen drawing)
def PollInputEvents()           // Register all input events
def WaitTime(seconds : double)  // Wait for some time (halt program execution)

// Random values generation functions
def SetRandomSeed(seed : uint)                                     // Set the seed for the random number generator
def GetRandomValue(min : int; max : int) : int                     // Get a random value between min and max (both included)
def LoadRandomSequence(count : uint; min : int; max : int) : int?  // Load random values sequence, no values repeated
def UnloadRandomSequence(sequence : int?)                          // Unload random values sequence

// Misc. functions
def TakeScreenshot(fileName : string)    // Takes a screenshot of current screen (filename extension defines format)
def SetConfigFlags(flags : uint)         // Set init configuration flags (view FLAGS)
def SetConfigFlags(flags : ConfigFlags)  // raylib_boost overload, takes the enum directly
def OpenURL(url : string)                // Open URL with default system browser (if available)

// Logging system
def SetTraceLogLevel(logLevel : int)  // Set the current threshold (minimum) log level

// Memory management, using internal allocators
def MemAlloc(size : uint) : void?                 // Internal memory allocator
def MemRealloc(ptr : void?; size : uint) : void?  // Internal memory reallocator
def MemFree(ptr : void?)                          // Internal memory free

// File system management functions
def LoadFileData(fileName : string; dataSize : int?) : uint8?             // Load file data as byte array (read)
def UnloadFileData(data : uint8?)                                         // Unload file data allocated by LoadFileData()

def FileRename(fileName : string; fileRename : string) : int              // Rename file (if exists), returns 0 on success
def FileRemove(fileName : string) : int                                   // Remove file (if exists), returns 0 on success
def FileCopy(srcPath : string; dstPath : string) : int                    // Copy file from one path to another, dstPath created if it doesn't exist, returns 0 on success
def FileMove(srcPath : string; dstPath : string) : int                    // Move file from one directory to another, dstPath created if it doesn't exist, returns 0 on success
def FileTextReplace(fileName : string; search : string; replacement : string) : int  // Replace text in an existing file, returns 0 on success

def GetWorkingDirectory() : string                                        // Get current working directory (uses static string)

def MakeDirectory(dirPath : string) : int                                 // Create directories (including full path requested), returns 0 on success

def IsPathFile(path : string) : bool                                      // Check if provided path points to a file
def IsPathDirectory(path : string) : bool                                 // Check if provided path points to a directory

def LoadDirectoryFiles(dirPath : string) : FilePathList                   // Load directory filepaths, files and directories, no subdirs scan
def LoadDirectoryFilesEx(basePath : string; filter : string; scanSubdirs : bool) : FilePathList  // Load directory filepaths with extension filtering and subdir scan; some filters available: '*.*','FILES*','DIRS*'

// Compression/Encoding functionality

def EncodeDataBase64(data : uint8 const?; dataSize : int; outputSize : int?) : string  // Encode data to Base64 string (includes NULL terminator), memory must be MemFree()

def ComputeCRC32(data : uint8 const?; dataSize : int) : uint     // Compute CRC32 hash code
def ComputeMD5(data : uint8 const?; dataSize : int) : uint?      // Compute MD5 hash code, returns static int[4] (16 bytes)
def ComputeSHA1(data : uint8 const?; dataSize : int) : uint?     // Compute SHA1 hash code, returns static int[5] (20 bytes)
def ComputeSHA256(data : uint8 const?; dataSize : int) : uint?   // Compute SHA256 hash code, returns static int[8] (32 bytes)

def SetAutomationEventList(list : AutomationEventList?)               // Set automation event list to record to

module: rtext

// Font Loading and Text Drawing Functions

// Font loading/unloading functions
def GetFontDefault() : Font                                                 // Get the default Font
def LoadFont(fileName : string) : Font                                      // Load font from file into GPU memory (VRAM)
def LoadFontEx(fileName : string; fontSize : int; codepoints : int const?; codepointCount : int) : Font  // Load font from file with defined codepoints and generation size, use NULL for codepoints and 0 for codepointCount to load the default character set, font size is provided in pixels height
def LoadFontFromImage(image : Image; key : float4; firstChar : int) : Font  // Load font from Image (XNA style)
def LoadFontFromMemory(fileType : string; fileData : uint8 const?; dataSize : int; fontSize : int; codepoints : int const?; codepointCount : int) : Font  // Load font from memory buffer, fileType refers to extension: i.e. '.ttf'
def IsFontValid(font : Font) : bool                                         // Check if font is valid (font data loaded, WARNING: GPU texture not checked)
def LoadFontData(fileData : uint8 const?; dataSize : int; fontSize : int; codepoints : int const?; codepointCount : int; type : int; glyphCount : int?) : GlyphInfo?  // Load font data for further use
def GenImageFontAtlas(glyphs : GlyphInfo const?; glyphRecs : float4??; glyphCount : int; fontSize : int; padding : int; packMethod : int) : Image  // Generate image font atlas using chars info
def UnloadFontData(glyphs : GlyphInfo?; glyphCount : int)                   // Unload font chars info data (RAM)
def UnloadFont(font : Font)                                                 // Unload font from GPU memory (VRAM)
def ExportFontAsCode(font : Font; fileName : string) : bool                 // Export font as code file, returns true on success

// Text drawing functions
def DrawFPS(posX : int; posY : int)  // Draw current FPS
def DrawText(text : string; posX : int; posY : int; fontSize : int; color : float4)  // Draw text (using default font)
def DrawTextEx(font : Font; text : string; position : float2; fontSize : float; spacing : float; tint : float4)  // Draw text using font and additional parameters
def DrawTextPro(font : Font; text : string; position : float2; origin : float2; rotation : float; fontSize : float; spacing : float; tint : float4)  // Draw text using Font and pro parameters (rotation)
def DrawTextCodepoint(font : Font; codepoint : int; position : float2; fontSize : float; tint : float4)  // Draw one character (codepoint)
def DrawTextCodepoints(font : Font; codepoints : int const?; codepointCount : int; position : float2; fontSize : float; spacing : float; tint : float4)  // Draw multiple characters (codepoint)

// Text font info functions
def SetTextLineSpacing(spacing : int)                        // Set vertical line spacing when drawing with line-breaks
def MeasureText(text : string; fontSize : int) : int         // Measure string width for default font
def MeasureTextEx(font : Font; text : string; fontSize : float; spacing : float) : float2  // Measure string size for Font
def MeasureTextCodepoints(font : Font; codepoints : int const?; length : int; fontSize : float; spacing : float) : float2  // Measure string size for an existing array of codepoints for Font
def GetGlyphIndex(font : Font; codepoint : int) : int        // Get glyph index position in font for a codepoint (unicode character), fallback to '?' if not found
def GetGlyphInfo(font : Font; codepoint : int) : GlyphInfo   // Get glyph font info data for a codepoint (unicode character), fallback to '?' if not found
def GetGlyphAtlasRec(font : Font; codepoint : int) : float4  // Get glyph rectangle in font atlas for a codepoint (unicode character), fallback to '?' if not found

// Text codepoints management functions (unicode characters)
def LoadUTF8(codepoints : int const?; length : int) : string         // Load UTF-8 text encoded from codepoints array
def UnloadUTF8(text : string)                                        // Unload UTF-8 text encoded from codepoints array
def LoadCodepoints(text : string; count : int?) : int?               // Load all codepoints from a UTF-8 text string, codepoints count returned by parameter
def UnloadCodepoints(codepoints : int?)                              // Unload codepoints data from memory
def GetCodepointCount(text : string) : int                           // Get total number of codepoints in a UTF-8 encoded string

def GetCodepointPrevious(text : string; codepointSize : int?) : int  // Get previous codepoint in a UTF-8 encoded string, 0x3f('?') is returned on failure
def CodepointToUTF8(codepoint : int; utf8Size : int?) : string       // Encode one codepoint into UTF-8 byte array (array length returned as parameter)

// Text strings management functions (no UTF-8 strings, only byte chars)
// WARNING 1: Most of these functions use internal static buffers[], it's recommended to store returned data on user-side for re-use
// WARNING 2: Some functions allocate memory internally for the returned strings, those strings must be freed by user using MemFree()
def LoadTextLines(text : string; count : int?) : string?                      // Load text as separate lines ('\n')
def UnloadTextLines(text : string?; lineCount : int)                          // Unload text lines

def TextLength(text : string) : uint                                          // Get text length, checks for '\0' ending
def TextSubtext(text : string; position : int; length : int) : string         // Get a piece of a text string
def TextRemoveSpaces(text : string) : string                                  // Remove text spaces, concat words
def GetTextBetween(text : string; begin : string; end : string) : string      // Get text between two strings
def TextReplace(text : string; search : string; replacement : string) : string  // Replace text string with new string
def TextReplaceAlloc(text : string; search : string; replacement : string) : string  // Replace text string with new string, memory must be MemFree()
def TextReplaceBetween(text : string; begin : string; end : string; replacement : string) : string  // Replace text between two specific strings
def TextReplaceBetweenAlloc(text : string; begin : string; end : string; replacement : string) : string  // Replace text between two specific strings, memory must be MemFree()
def TextInsert(text : string; insert : string; position : int) : string       // Insert text in a defined byte position
def TextInsertAlloc(text : string; insert : string; position : int) : string  // Insert text in a defined byte position, memory must be MemFree()
def TextJoin(textList : string?; count : int; delimiter : string) : string    // Join text strings with delimiter
def TextSplit(text : string; delimiter : int8; count : int?) : string?        // Split text into multiple strings, using MAX_TEXTSPLIT_COUNT static strings
def TextAppend(text : string; append : string; position : int?)               // Append text at specific position and move cursor
def TextFindIndex(text : string; search : string) : int                       // Find first text occurrence within a string, -1 if not found
def TextToUpper(text : string) : string                                       // Get upper case version of provided string
def TextToLower(text : string) : string                                       // Get lower case version of provided string
def TextToPascal(text : string) : string                                      // Get Pascal case notation version of provided string
def TextToSnake(text : string) : string                                       // Get Snake case notation version of provided string
def TextToCamel(text : string) : string                                       // Get Camel case notation version of provided string
def TextToInteger(text : string) : int                                        // Get integer value from text
def TextToFloat(text : string) : float                                        // Get float value from text

module: raudio

// Audio Loading and Playing Functions

// Audio device management functions
def InitAudioDevice()                // Initialize audio device and context
def CloseAudioDevice()               // Close the audio device and context
def IsAudioDeviceReady() : bool      // Check if audio device has been initialized successfully
def SetMasterVolume(volume : float)  // Set master volume (listener)
def GetMasterVolume() : float        // Get master volume (listener)

// Wave/Sound loading/unloading functions
def LoadWave(fileName : string) : Wave                          // Load wave data from file
def LoadWaveFromMemory(fileType : string; fileData : uint8 const?; dataSize : int) : Wave  // Load wave from memory buffer, fileType refers to extension: i.e. '.wav'
def IsWaveValid(wave : Wave) : bool                             // Check if wave data is valid (data loaded and parameters)
def LoadSound(fileName : string) : Sound                        // Load sound from file
def LoadSoundFromWave(wave : Wave) : Sound                      // Load sound from wave data
def LoadSoundAlias(source : Sound) : Sound                      // Load sound alias, new sound that shares the same sample data as the source sound, does not own the sound data
def IsSoundValid(sound : Sound) : bool                          // Check if sound is valid (data loaded and buffers initialized)
def UpdateSound(sound : Sound; data : void?; frameCount : int)  // Update sound buffer with new data (default data format: 32 bit float, stereo)
def UnloadWave(wave : Wave)                                     // Unload wave data
def UnloadSound(sound : Sound)                                  // Unload sound
def UnloadSoundAlias(alias : Sound)                             // Unload sound alias (does not deallocate sample data)
def ExportWave(wave : Wave; fileName : string) : bool           // Export wave data to file, returns true on success
def ExportWaveAsCode(wave : Wave; fileName : string) : bool     // Export wave sample data to code (.h), returns true on success

// Wave/Sound management functions
def PlaySound(sound : Sound)                                   // Play a sound
def StopSound(sound : Sound)                                   // Stop playing a sound
def PauseSound(sound : Sound)                                  // Pause a sound
def ResumeSound(sound : Sound)                                 // Resume a paused sound
def IsSoundPlaying(sound : Sound) : bool                       // Check if sound is currently playing
def SetSoundVolume(sound : Sound; volume : float)              // Set volume for a sound (1.0 is max level)
def SetSoundPitch(sound : Sound; pitch : float)                // Set pitch for a sound (1.0 is base level)
def SetSoundPan(sound : Sound; pan : float)                    // Set pan for a sound (-1.0 left, 0.0 center, 1.0 right)
def WaveCopy(wave : Wave) : Wave                               // Copy a wave to a new wave
def WaveCrop(wave : Wave?; initFrame : int; finalFrame : int)  // Crop a wave to defined frames range
def WaveFormat(wave : Wave?; sampleRate : int; sampleSize : int; channels : int)  // Convert wave data to desired format
def LoadWaveSamples(wave : Wave) : float?                      // Load samples data from wave as a 32bit float data array
def UnloadWaveSamples(samples : float?)                        // Unload samples data loaded with LoadWaveSamples()

// Music management functions
def LoadMusicStream(fileName : string) : Music        // Load music stream from file
def LoadMusicStreamFromMemory(fileType : string; data : uint8 const?; dataSize : int) : Music  // Load music stream from data
def IsMusicValid(music : Music) : bool                // Check if music stream is valid (context and buffers initialized)
def UnloadMusicStream(music : Music)                  // Unload music stream
def PlayMusicStream(music : Music)                    // Start music playing
def IsMusicStreamPlaying(music : Music) : bool        // Check if music is playing
def UpdateMusicStream(music : Music)                  // Update buffers for music streaming
def StopMusicStream(music : Music)                    // Stop music playing
def PauseMusicStream(music : Music)                   // Pause music playing
def ResumeMusicStream(music : Music)                  // Resume playing paused music
def SeekMusicStream(music : Music; position : float)  // Seek music to a position (in seconds)
def SetMusicVolume(music : Music; volume : float)     // Set volume for music (1.0 is max level)
def SetMusicPitch(music : Music; pitch : float)       // Set pitch for music (1.0 is base level)
def SetMusicPan(music : Music; pan : float)           // Set pan for music (-1.0 left, 0.0 center, 1.0 right)
def GetMusicTimeLength(music : Music) : float         // Get music time length (in seconds)
def GetMusicTimePlayed(music : Music) : float         // Get current music time played (in seconds)

// AudioStream management functions
def LoadAudioStream(sampleRate : uint; sampleSize : uint; channels : uint) : AudioStream  // Load audio stream (to stream raw audio pcm data)
def IsAudioStreamValid(stream : AudioStream) : bool                          // Check if an audio stream is valid (buffers initialized)
def UnloadAudioStream(stream : AudioStream)                                  // Unload audio stream and free memory
def UpdateAudioStream(stream : AudioStream; data : void?; frameCount : int)  // Update audio stream buffers with data
def IsAudioStreamProcessed(stream : AudioStream) : bool                      // Check if any audio stream buffers requires refill
def PlayAudioStream(stream : AudioStream)                                    // Play audio stream
def PauseAudioStream(stream : AudioStream)                                   // Pause audio stream
def ResumeAudioStream(stream : AudioStream)                                  // Resume audio stream
def IsAudioStreamPlaying(stream : AudioStream) : bool                        // Check if audio stream is playing
def StopAudioStream(stream : AudioStream)                                    // Stop audio stream
def SetAudioStreamVolume(stream : AudioStream; volume : float)               // Set volume for audio stream (1.0 is max level)
def SetAudioStreamPitch(stream : AudioStream; pitch : float)                 // Set pitch for audio stream (1.0 is base level)
def SetAudioStreamPan(stream : AudioStream; pan : float)                     // Set pan for audio stream (-1.0 left, 0.0 center, 1.0 right)
def SetAudioStreamBufferSizeDefault(size : int)                              // Default size for new audio streams

    COMPRESSED_DXT5_RGBA = 17
    COMPRESSED_ETC1_RGB = 18
    COMPRESSED_ETC2_RGB = 19
    COMPRESSED_ETC2_EAC_RGBA = 20
    COMPRESSED_PVRT_RGB = 21
    COMPRESSED_PVRT_RGBA = 22
    COMPRESSED_ASTC_4x4_RGBA = 23
    COMPRESSED_ASTC_8x8_RGBA = 24

enum TextureFilter                      // Texture parameters: filter mode
    TEXTURE_FILTER_POINT = 0            // No filter, pixel approximation
    TEXTURE_FILTER_BILINEAR = 1         // Linear filtering
    TEXTURE_FILTER_TRILINEAR = 2        // Trilinear filtering (linear with mipmaps)
    TEXTURE_FILTER_ANISOTROPIC_4X = 3   // Anisotropic filtering 4x
    TEXTURE_FILTER_ANISOTROPIC_8X = 4   // Anisotropic filtering 8x
    TEXTURE_FILTER_ANISOTROPIC_16X = 5  // Anisotropic filtering 16x

enum TextureWrap                    // Texture parameters: wrap mode
    TEXTURE_WRAP_REPEAT = 0         // Repeats texture in tiled mode
    TEXTURE_WRAP_CLAMP = 1          // Clamps texture to edge pixel in tiled mode
    TEXTURE_WRAP_MIRROR_REPEAT = 2  // Mirrors and repeats the texture in tiled mode
    TEXTURE_WRAP_MIRROR_CLAMP = 3   // Mirrors and clamps to border the texture in tiled mode

enum CubemapLayout                          // Cubemap layouts
    CUBEMAP_LAYOUT_AUTO_DETECT = 0          // Automatically detect layout type
    CUBEMAP_LAYOUT_LINE_VERTICAL = 1        // Layout is defined by a vertical line with faces
    CUBEMAP_LAYOUT_LINE_HORIZONTAL = 2      // Layout is defined by a horizontal line with faces
    CUBEMAP_LAYOUT_CROSS_THREE_BY_FOUR = 3  // Layout is defined by a 3x4 cross with cubemap faces
    CUBEMAP_LAYOUT_CROSS_FOUR_BY_THREE = 4  // Layout is defined by a 4x3 cross with cubemap faces

enum FontType         // Font type, defines generation method
    FONT_DEFAULT = 0  // Default font generation, anti-aliased
    FONT_BITMAP = 1   // Bitmap font generation, no anti-aliasing
    FONT_SDF = 2      // SDF font generation, requires external shader

enum BlendMode                   // Color blending modes (pre-defined)
    BLEND_ALPHA = 0              // Blend textures considering alpha (default)
    BLEND_ADDITIVE = 1           // Blend textures adding colors
    BLEND_MULTIPLIED = 2         // Blend textures multiplying colors
    BLEND_ADD_COLORS = 3         // Blend textures adding colors (alternative)
    BLEND_SUBTRACT_COLORS = 4    // Blend textures subtracting colors (alternative)
    BLEND_ALPHA_PREMULTIPLY = 5  // Blend premultiplied textures considering alpha
    BLEND_CUSTOM = 6             // Blend textures using custom src/dst factors (use rlSetBlendFactors())
    BLEND_CUSTOM_SEPARATE = 7    // Blend textures using custom rgb/alpha separate src/dst factors (use rlSetBlendFactorsSeparate())

enum Gesture          // Gesture
    NONE = 0
    TAP = 1
    DOUBLETAP = 2
    HOLD = 4
    DRAG = 8
    SWIPE_RIGHT = 16
    SWIPE_LEFT = 32
    SWIPE_UP = 64
    SWIPE_DOWN = 128
    PINCH_IN = 256
    PINCH_OUT = 512

enum CameraMode              // Camera system modes
    CAMERA_CUSTOM = 0        // Camera custom, controlled by user (UpdateCamera() does nothing)
    CAMERA_FREE = 1          // Camera free mode
    CAMERA_ORBITAL = 2       // Camera orbital, around target, zoom supported
    CAMERA_FIRST_PERSON = 3  // Camera first person
    CAMERA_THIRD_PERSON = 4  // Camera third person

enum CameraProjection        // Camera projection
    CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE = 0   // Perspective projection
    CAMERA_ORTHOGRAPHIC = 1  // Orthographic projection

enum NPatchLayout                      // N-patch layout
    NPATCH_NINE_PATCH = 0              // Npatch layout: 3x3 tiles
    NPATCH_THREE_PATCH_VERTICAL = 1    // Npatch layout: 1x3 tiles
    NPATCH_THREE_PATCH_HORIZONTAL = 2  // Npatch layout: 3x1 tiles

module: rshapes

// Basic Shapes Drawing Functions

// Set texture and rectangle to be used on shapes drawing
// NOTE: It can be useful when using basic shapes and one single font,
// defining a font char white rectangle would allow drawing everything in a single draw call
def SetShapesTexture(texture : Texture; rec : float4)  // Set texture and rectangle to be used on shapes drawing
def GetShapesTexture() : Texture                       // Get texture that is used for shapes drawing
def GetShapesTextureRectangle() : float4               // Get texture source rectangle that is used for shapes drawing

// Basic shapes drawing functions
def DrawPixel(posX : int; posY : int; color : float4)                         // Draw a pixel using geometry [Can be slow, use with care]
def DrawPixelV(position : float2; color : float4)                             // Draw a pixel using geometry (Vector version) [Can be slow, use with care]
def DrawLine(startPosX : int; startPosY : int; endPosX : int; endPosY : int; color : float4)  // Draw a line
def DrawLineV(startPos : float2; endPos : float2; color : float4)             // Draw a line (using gl lines)
def DrawLineEx(startPos : float2; endPos : float2; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw a line (using triangles/quads)
def DrawLineStrip(points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; color : float4)   // Draw lines sequence (using gl lines)
def DrawLineBezier(startPos : float2; endPos : float2; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw line segment cubic-bezier in-out interpolation
def DrawLineDashed(startPos : float2; endPos : float2; dashSize : int; spaceSize : int; color : float4)  // Draw a dashed line
def DrawTriangle(v1 : float2; v2 : float2; v3 : float2; color : float4)       // Draw a color-filled triangle, counter-clockwise vertex order
def DrawTriangleGradient(v1 : float2; v2 : float2; v3 : float2; c1 : float4; c2 : float4; c3 : float4)  // Draw triangle with interpolated colors, counter-clockwise vertex/color order
def DrawTriangleLines(v1 : float2; v2 : float2; v3 : float2; color : float4)  // Draw triangle outline, counter-clockwise vertex order
def DrawTriangleLinesEx(v1 : float2; v2 : float2; v3 : float2; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw triangle outline with line thickness, counter-clockwise vertex order
def DrawTriangleFan(points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; color : float4)  // Draw a triangle fan defined by points (first vertex is the center)
def DrawTriangleStrip(points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; color : float4)  // Draw a triangle strip defined by points
def DrawRectangle(posX : int; posY : int; width : int; height : int; color : float4)  // Draw a color-filled rectangle
def DrawRectangleV(position : float2; size : float2; color : float4)          // Draw a color-filled rectangle (Vector version)
def DrawRectangleRec(rec : float4; color : float4)                            // Draw a color-filled rectangle
def DrawRectanglePro(rec : float4; origin : float2; rotation : float; color : float4)  // Draw a color-filled rectangle with pro parameters
def DrawRectangleGradientV(posX : int; posY : int; width : int; height : int; top : float4; bottom : float4)  // Draw a vertical-gradient-filled rectangle
def DrawRectangleGradientH(posX : int; posY : int; width : int; height : int; left : float4; right : float4)  // Draw a horizontal-gradient-filled rectangle
def DrawRectangleGradientEx(rec : float4; col1 : float4; col2 : float4; col3 : float4; col4 : float4)  // Draw a gradient-filled rectangle with custom vertex colors, counter-clockwise color order
def DrawRectangleLines(posX : int; posY : int; width : int; height : int; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle outline
def DrawRectangleLinesEx(rec : float4; thick : float; color : float4)         // Draw rectangle outline with line thickness
def DrawRectangleRounded(rec : float4; roundness : float; segments : int; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle with rounded edges
def DrawRectangleRoundedLines(rec : float4; roundness : float; segments : int; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle lines with rounded edges
def DrawRectangleRoundedLinesEx(rec : float4; roundness : float; segments : int; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle lines with rounded edges outline and line thickness
def DrawPoly(center : float2; sides : int; radius : float; rotation : float; color : float4)  // Draw a polygon of n sides
def DrawPolyLines(center : float2; sides : int; radius : float; rotation : float; color : float4)  // Draw a polygon outline of n sides
def DrawPolyLinesEx(center : float2; sides : int; radius : float; rotation : float; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw a polygon outline of n sides with line thickness
def DrawCircle(centerX : int; centerY : int; radius : float; color : float4)  // Draw a color-filled circle
def DrawCircleV(center : float2; radius : float; color : float4)              // Draw a color-filled circle (Vector version)
def DrawCircleGradient(center : float2; radius : float; inner : float4; outer : float4)  // Draw a gradient-filled circle
def DrawCircleSector(center : float2; radius : float; startAngle : float; endAngle : float; segments : int; color : float4)  // Draw a piece of a circle
def DrawCircleSectorLines(center : float2; radius : float; startAngle : float; endAngle : float; segments : int; color : float4)  // Draw circle sector outline
def DrawCircleSectorLinesEx(center : float2; radius : float; startAngle : float; endAngle : float; segments : int; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw circle sector outline with thickness
def DrawCircleLines(centerX : int; centerY : int; radius : float; color : float4)  // Draw circle outline
def DrawCircleLinesV(center : float2; radius : float; color : float4)         // Draw circle outline (Vector version)
def DrawCircleLinesEx(center : float2; radius : float; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw circle outline with line thickness
def DrawEllipse(centerX : int; centerY : int; radiusH : float; radiusV : float; color : float4)  // Draw ellipse
def DrawEllipseV(center : float2; radiusH : float; radiusV : float; color : float4)  // Draw ellipse (Vector version)
def DrawEllipseLines(centerX : int; centerY : int; radiusH : float; radiusV : float; color : float4)  // Draw ellipse outline
def DrawEllipseLinesV(center : float2; radiusH : float; radiusV : float; color : float4)  // Draw ellipse outline (Vector version)
def DrawEllipseLinesEx(center : float2; radiusH : float; radiusV : float; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw ellipse outline with line thickness
def DrawRing(center : float2; innerRadius : float; outerRadius : float; startAngle : float; endAngle : float; segments : int; color : float4)  // Draw ring
def DrawRingLines(center : float2; innerRadius : float; outerRadius : float; startAngle : float; endAngle : float; segments : int; color : float4)  // Draw ring outline
def DrawRingLinesEx(center : float2; innerRadius : float; outerRadius : float; startAngle : float; endAngle : float; segments : int; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw ring outline with line thickness

// Splines drawing functions
def DrawSplineLinear(points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw spline: Linear, minimum 2 points
def DrawSplineBasis(points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw spline: B-Spline, minimum 4 points
def DrawSplineCatmullRom(points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw spline: Catmull-Rom, minimum 4 points
def DrawSplineBezierQuadratic(points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw spline: Quadratic Bezier, minimum 3 points (1 control point): [p1, c2, p3, c4...]
def DrawSplineBezierCubic(points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw spline: Cubic Bezier, minimum 4 points (2 control points): [p1, c2, c3, p4, c5, c6...]
def DrawSplineSegmentLinear(p1 : float2; p2 : float2; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw spline segment: Linear, 2 points
def DrawSplineSegmentBasis(p1 : float2; p2 : float2; p3 : float2; p4 : float2; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw spline segment: B-Spline, 4 points
def DrawSplineSegmentCatmullRom(p1 : float2; p2 : float2; p3 : float2; p4 : float2; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw spline segment: Catmull-Rom, 4 points
def DrawSplineSegmentBezierQuadratic(p1 : float2; c2 : float2; p3 : float2; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw spline segment: Quadratic Bezier, 2 points, 1 control point
def DrawSplineSegmentBezierCubic(p1 : float2; c2 : float2; c3 : float2; p4 : float2; thick : float; color : float4)  // Draw spline segment: Cubic Bezier, 2 points, 2 control points

// Spline segment point evaluation functions, for a provided t [0.0f .. 1.0f]
def GetSplinePointLinear(startPos : float2; endPos : float2; t : float) : float2  // Get (evaluate) spline point: Linear
def GetSplinePointBasis(p1 : float2; p2 : float2; p3 : float2; p4 : float2; t : float) : float2  // Get (evaluate) spline point: B-Spline
def GetSplinePointCatmullRom(p1 : float2; p2 : float2; p3 : float2; p4 : float2; t : float) : float2  // Get (evaluate) spline point: Catmull-Rom
def GetSplinePointBezierQuadratic(p1 : float2; c2 : float2; p3 : float2; t : float) : float2  // Get (evaluate) spline point: Quadratic Bezier
def GetSplinePointBezierCubic(p1 : float2; c2 : float2; c3 : float2; p4 : float2; t : float) : float2  // Get (evaluate) spline point: Cubic Bezier

// Basic shapes collision detection functions
def CheckCollisionRecs(rec1 : float4; rec2 : float4) : bool      // Check collision between two rectangles
def CheckCollisionCircles(center1 : float2; radius1 : float; center2 : float2; radius2 : float) : bool  // Check collision between two circles
def CheckCollisionCircleRec(center : float2; radius : float; rec : float4) : bool  // Check collision between circle and rectangle
def CheckCollisionCircleLine(center : float2; radius : float; p1 : float2; p2 : float2) : bool  // Check if circle collides with a line created between two points [p1] and [p2]
def CheckCollisionPointRec(point : float2; rec : float4) : bool  // Check if point is inside rectangle
def CheckCollisionPointCircle(point : float2; center : float2; radius : float) : bool  // Check if point is inside circle
def CheckCollisionPointTriangle(point : float2; p1 : float2; p2 : float2; p3 : float2) : bool  // Check if point is inside a triangle
def CheckCollisionPointLine(point : float2; p1 : float2; p2 : float2; threshold : int) : bool  // Check if point belongs to line created between two points [p1] and [p2] with defined margin in pixels [threshold]
def CheckCollisionPointPoly(point : float2; points : float2 const?; pointCount : int) : bool  // Check if point is within a polygon described by array of vertices
def CheckCollisionLines(startPos1 : float2; endPos1 : float2; startPos2 : float2; endPos2 : float2; collisionPoint : float2?) : bool  // Check the collision between two lines defined by two points each, returns collision point by reference
def GetCollisionRec(rec1 : float4; rec2 : float4) : float4       // Get collision rectangle for two rectangles collision

module: rtextures

// Texture Loading and Drawing Functions

// Image loading functions
// NOTE: These functions do not require GPU access
def LoadImage(fileName : string) : Image                        // Load image from file into CPU memory (RAM)
def LoadImageRaw(fileName : string; width : int; height : int; format : int; headerSize : int) : Image  // Load image from RAW file data
def LoadImageAnim(fileName : string; frames : int?) : Image     // Load image sequence from file (frames appended to image.data)
def LoadImageAnimFromMemory(fileType : string; fileData : uint8 const?; dataSize : int; frames : int?) : Image  // Load image sequence from memory buffer
def LoadImageFromMemory(fileType : string; fileData : uint8 const?; dataSize : int) : Image  // Load image from memory buffer, fileType refers to extension: i.e. '.png'
def LoadImageFromTexture(texture : Texture) : Image             // Load image from GPU texture data
def LoadImageFromScreen() : Image                               // Load image from screen buffer (screenshot)
def IsImageValid(image : Image) : bool                          // Check if an image is valid (data and parameters)
def UnloadImage(image : Image)                                  // Unload image from CPU memory (RAM)
def ExportImage(image : Image; fileName : string) : bool        // Export image data to file, returns true on success
def ExportImageToMemory(image : Image; fileType : string; fileSize : int?) : uint8?  // Export image to memory buffer, memory must be MemFree()
def ExportImageAsCode(image : Image; fileName : string) : bool  // Export image as code file defining an array of bytes, returns true on success

// Image generation functions
def GenImageColor(width : int; height : int; color : float4) : Image       // Generate image: plain color
def GenImageGradientLinear(width : int; height : int; direction : int; start : float4; end : float4) : Image  // Generate image: linear gradient, direction in degrees [0..360], 0=Vertical gradient
def GenImageGradientRadial(width : int; height : int; density : float; inner : float4; outer : float4) : Image  // Generate image: radial gradient
def GenImageGradientSquare(width : int; height : int; density : float; inner : float4; outer : float4) : Image  // Generate image: square gradient
def GenImageChecked(width : int; height : int; checksX : int; checksY : int; col1 : float4; col2 : float4) : Image  // Generate image: checked
def GenImageWhiteNoise(width : int; height : int; factor : float) : Image  // Generate image: white noise
def GenImagePerlinNoise(width : int; height : int; offsetX : int; offsetY : int; scale : float) : Image  // Generate image: perlin noise
def GenImageCellular(width : int; height : int; tileSize : int) : Image    // Generate image: cellular algorithm, bigger tileSize means bigger cells
def GenImageText(width : int; height : int; text : string) : Image         // Generate image: grayscale image from text data

// Image manipulation functions
def ImageCopy(image : Image) : Image                                     // Create an image duplicate (useful for transformations)
def ImageFromImage(image : Image; rec : float4) : Image                  // Create an image from another image piece
def ImageFromChannel(image : Image; selectedChannel : int) : Image       // Create an image from a selected channel of another image (GRAYSCALE)
def ImageText(text : string; fontSize : int; color : float4) : Image     // Create an image from text (default font)
def ImageTextEx(font : Font; text : string; fontSize : float; spacing : float; tint : float4) : Image  // Create an image from text (custom sprite font)
def ImageFormat(image : Image?; newFormat : int)                         // Convert image data to desired format
def ImageToPOT(image : Image?; fill : float4)                            // Convert image to POT (power-of-two)
def ImageCrop(image : Image?; crop : float4)                             // Crop an image to a defined rectangle
def ImageAlphaCrop(image : Image?; threshold : float)                    // Crop image depending on alpha value
def ImageAlphaClear(image : Image?; color : float4; threshold : float)   // Clear alpha channel to desired color
def ImageAlphaMask(image : Image?; alphaMask : Image)                    // Apply alpha mask to image
def ImageAlphaPremultiply(image : Image?)                                // Premultiply alpha channel
def ImageBlurGaussian(image : Image?; blurSize : int)                    // Apply Gaussian blur using a box blur approximation
def ImageKernelConvolution(image : Image?; kernel : float const?; kernelSize : int)  // Apply custom square convolution kernel to image
def ImageResize(image : Image?; newWidth : int; newHeight : int)         // Resize image (Bicubic scaling algorithm)
def ImageResizeNN(image : Image?; newWidth : int; newHeight : int)       // Resize image (Nearest-Neighbor scaling algorithm)
def ImageResizeCanvas(image : Image?; newWidth : int; newHeight : int; offsetX : int; offsetY : int; fill : float4)  // Resize canvas and fill with color
def ImageMipmaps(image : Image?)                                         // Compute all mipmap levels for a provided image
def ImageDither(image : Image?; rBpp : int; gBpp : int; bBpp : int; aBpp : int)  // Dither image data to 16bpp or lower (Floyd-Steinberg dithering)
def ImageFlipVertical(image : Image?)                                    // Flip image vertically
def ImageFlipHorizontal(image : Image?)                                  // Flip image horizontally
def ImageRotate(image : Image?; degrees : int)                           // Rotate image by input angle in degrees (-359 to 359)
def ImageRotateCW(image : Image?)                                        // Rotate image clockwise 90deg
def ImageRotateCCW(image : Image?)                                       // Rotate image counter-clockwise 90deg
def ImageColorTint(image : Image?; color : float4)                       // Modify image color: tint
def ImageColorInvert(image : Image?)                                     // Modify image color: invert
def ImageColorGrayscale(image : Image?)                                  // Modify image color: grayscale
def ImageColorContrast(image : Image?; contrast : int)                   // Modify image color: contrast (-100 to 100)
def ImageColorBrightness(image : Image?; brightness : int)               // Modify image color: brightness (-255 to 255)
def ImageColorReplace(image : Image?; color : float4; replace : float4)  // Modify image color: replace color
def LoadImageColors(image : Image) : Color?                              // Load color data from image as a Color array (RGBA - 32bit)
def LoadImagePalette(image : Image; maxPaletteSize : int; colorCount : int?) : Color?  // Load colors palette from image as a Color array (RGBA - 32bit)
def UnloadImageColors(colors : Color?)                                   // Unload color data loaded with LoadImageColors()
def UnloadImagePalette(colors : Color?)                                  // Unload colors palette loaded with LoadImagePalette()
def GetImageAlphaBorder(image : Image; threshold : float) : float4       // Get image alpha border rectangle
def GetImageColor(image : Image; x : int; y : int) : float4              // Get image pixel color at (x, y) position

// Image drawing functions
// NOTE: Image software-rendering functions (CPU)
def ImageClearBackground(dst : Image?; color : float4)                    // Clear image background with provided color
def ImageDrawPixel(dst : Image?; posX : int; posY : int; color : float4)  // Draw pixel within an image
def ImageDrawPixelV(dst : Image?; position : float2; color : float4)      // Draw pixel within an image (Vector version)
def ImageDrawLine(dst : Image?; startPosX : int; startPosY : int; endPosX : int; endPosY : int; color : float4)  // Draw line within an image
def ImageDrawLineV(dst : Image?; start : float2; end : float2; color : float4)  // Draw line within an image (Vector version)
def ImageDrawLineEx(dst : Image?; start : float2; end : float2; thick : int; color : float4)  // Draw a line defining thickness within an image
def ImageDrawLineStrip(dst : Image?; points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; color : float4)  // Draw a lines sequence within an image
def ImageDrawTriangle(dst : Image?; v1 : float2; v2 : float2; v3 : float2; color : float4)  // Draw triangle within an image
def ImageDrawTriangleGradient(dst : Image?; v1 : float2; v2 : float2; v3 : float2; c1 : float4; c2 : float4; c3 : float4)  // Draw triangle with interpolated colors within an image
def ImageDrawTriangleLines(dst : Image?; v1 : float2; v2 : float2; v3 : float2; color : float4)  // Draw triangle outline within an image
def ImageDrawTriangleFan(dst : Image?; points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; color : float4)  // Draw a triangle fan defined by points within an image (first vertex is the center)
def ImageDrawTriangleStrip(dst : Image?; points : float2 const?; pointCount : int; color : float4)  // Draw a triangle strip defined by points within an image
def ImageDrawRectangle(dst : Image?; posX : int; posY : int; width : int; height : int; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle within an image
def ImageDrawRectangleV(dst : Image?; position : float2; size : float2; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle within an image (Vector version)
def ImageDrawRectangleRec(dst : Image?; rec : float4; color : float4)     // Draw rectangle within an image
def ImageDrawRectanglePro(dst : Image?; rec : float4; origin : float2; rotation : float; color : float4)  // Draw a color-filled rectangle with pro parameters within and image
def ImageDrawRectangleLines(dst : Image?; posX : int; posY : int; width : int; height : int; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle lines within an image
def ImageDrawRectangleLinesEx(dst : Image?; rec : float4; thick : int; color : float4)  // Draw rectangle lines within an image with line thickness
def ImageDrawRectangleGradientEx(dst : Image?; rec : float4; col1 : float4; col2 : float4; col3 : float4; col4 : float4)  // Draw rectangle with gradient colors within an image, counter-clockwise color order
def ImageDrawCircle(dst : Image?; centerX : int; centerY : int; radius : int; color : float4)  // Draw a filled circle within an image
def ImageDrawCircleV(dst : Image?; center : float2; radius : int; color : float4)  // Draw a filled circle within an image (Vector version)
def ImageDrawCircleLines(dst : Image?; centerX : int; centerY : int; radius : int; color : float4)  // Draw circle outline within an image
def ImageDrawCircleLinesV(dst : Image?; center : float2; radius : int; color : float4)  // Draw circle outline within an image (Vector version)
def ImageDrawCircleGradient(dst : Image?; center : float2; radius : float; inner : float4; outer : float4)  // Draw a gradient-filled circle within an image
def ImageDrawImage(dst : Image?; src : Image; posX : int; posY : int; tint : float4)  // Draw an image within an image
def ImageDrawImageEx(dst : Image?; src : Image; position : float2; rotation : float; scale : float; tint : float4)  // Draw an image with scaling and rotation within an image
def ImageDrawImageRec(dst : Image?; src : Image; srcRec : float4; position : float2; tint : float4)  // Draw a part of an image defined by a rectangle within an image
def ImageDrawImagePro(dst : Image?; src : Image; srcRec : float4; dstRec : float4; origin : float2; rotation : float; tint : float4)  // Draw a part of an image defined by a rectangle into destination rectangle, with scaling and rotation, within an image
def ImageDrawText(dst : Image?; text : string; posX : int; posY : int; fontSize : int; color : float4)  // Draw text (using default font) within an image (destination)
def ImageDrawTextEx(dst : Image?; font : Font; text : string; position : float2; fontSize : float; spacing : float; tint : float4)  // Draw text (custom sprite font) within an image (destination)
def ImageDrawTextPro(dst : Image?; font : Font; text : string; position : float2; origin : float2; rotation : float; fontSize : float; spacing : float; tint : float4)  // Draw text using Font and pro parameters (rotation)

// Texture loading functions
// NOTE: These functions require GPU access
def LoadTexture(fileName : string) : Texture                           // Load texture from file into GPU memory (VRAM)
def LoadTextureFromImage(image : Image) : Texture                      // Load texture from image data
def LoadTextureCubemap(image : Image; layout : int) : Texture          // Load cubemap from image, multiple image cubemap layouts supported
def LoadRenderTexture(width : int; height : int) : RenderTexture       // Load texture for rendering (framebuffer)
def LoadRenderTextureEx(width : int; height : int; format : int) : RenderTexture  // Load texture for rendering (framebuffer), with specific format
def IsTextureValid(texture : Texture) : bool                           // Check if texture is valid (loaded in GPU)
def UnloadTexture(texture : Texture)                                   // Unload texture from GPU memory (VRAM)
def IsRenderTextureValid(target : RenderTexture) : bool                // Check if render texture is valid (loaded in GPU)

struct Matrix    // Matrix, 4x4 components, column major, OpenGL style, right-handed
    m0 : float   // Matrix first row (4 components)
    m4 : float   // Matrix first row (4 components)
    m8 : float   // Matrix first row (4 components)
    m12 : float  // Matrix first row (4 components)
    m1 : float   // Matrix second row (4 components)
    m5 : float   // Matrix second row (4 components)
    m9 : float   // Matrix second row (4 components)
    m13 : float  // Matrix second row (4 components)
    m2 : float   // Matrix third row (4 components)
    m6 : float   // Matrix third row (4 components)
    m10 : float  // Matrix third row (4 components)
    m14 : float  // Matrix third row (4 components)
    m3 : float   // Matrix fourth row (4 components)
    m7 : float   // Matrix fourth row (4 components)
    m11 : float  // Matrix fourth row (4 components)
    m15 : float  // Matrix fourth row (4 components)

struct Color   // Color, 4 components, R8G8B8A8 (32bit)
    r : uint8  // Color red value
    g : uint8  // Color green value
    b : uint8  // Color blue value
    a : uint8  // Color alpha value

struct Image       // Image, pixel data stored in CPU memory (RAM)
    data : void?   // Image raw data
    width : int    // Image base width
    height : int   // Image base height
    mipmaps : int  // Mipmap levels, 1 by default
    format : int   // Data format (PixelFormat type)

struct Texture     // Texture, tex data stored in GPU memory (VRAM)
    id : uint      // OpenGL texture id
    width : int    // Texture base width
    height : int   // Texture base height
    mipmaps : int  // Mipmap levels, 1 by default
    format : int   // Data format (PixelFormat type)

struct RenderTexture   // RenderTexture, fbo for texture rendering
    id : uint          // OpenGL framebuffer object id
    texture : Texture  // Color buffer attachment texture
    depth : Texture    // Depth buffer attachment texture

struct NPatchInfo    // NPatchInfo, n-patch layout info
    source : float4  // Texture source rectangle
    left : int       // Left border offset
    top : int        // Top border offset
    right : int      // Right border offset
    bottom : int     // Bottom border offset
    layout : int     // Layout of the n-patch: 3x3, 1x3 or 3x1

struct GlyphInfo    // GlyphInfo, font characters glyphs info
    value : int     // Character value (Unicode)
    offsetX : int   // Character offset X when drawing
    offsetY : int   // Character offset Y when drawing
    advanceX : int  // Character advance position X
    image : Image   // Character image data

struct Font              // Font, font texture and GlyphInfo array data
    baseSize : int       // Base size (default chars height)
    glyphCount : int     // Number of glyph characters
    glyphPadding : int   // Padding around the glyph characters
    texture : Texture    // Texture atlas containing the glyphs
    recs : float4?       // Rectangles in texture for the glyphs
    glyphs : GlyphInfo?  // Glyphs info data

struct Camera3D        // Camera, defines position/orientation in 3d space
    position : float3  // Camera position
    target : float3    // Camera target it looks-at
    up : float3        // Camera up vector (rotation over its axis)
    fovy : float       // Camera field-of-view aperture in Y (degrees) in perspective, used as near plane height in world units in orthographic
    projection : int   // Camera projection: CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE or CAMERA_ORTHOGRAPHIC

struct Camera2D       // Camera2D, defines position/orientation in 2d space
    offset : float2   // Camera offset (screen space offset from window origin, unscaled by DPI, real pixel size)
    target : float2   // Camera target (world space target point that is mapped to screen space offset)
    rotation : float  // Camera rotation in degrees (pivots around target)
    zoom : float      // Camera zoom (scaling around target), must not be set to 0, set to 1.0f for no scale

struct Mesh                // Mesh, vertex data and vao/vbo
    vertexCount : int      // Number of vertices stored in arrays
    triangleCount : int    // Number of triangles stored (indexed or not)
    vertices : float?      // Vertex position (XYZ - 3 components per vertex) (shader-location = 0)
    texcoords : float?     // Vertex texture coordinates (UV - 2 components per vertex) (shader-location = 1)
    texcoords2 : float?    // Vertex texture second coordinates (UV - 2 components per vertex) (shader-location = 5)
    normals : float?       // Vertex normals (XYZ - 3 components per vertex) (shader-location = 2)
    tangents : float?      // Vertex tangents (XYZW - 4 components per vertex) (shader-location = 4)
    colors : uint8?        // Vertex colors (RGBA - 4 components per vertex) (shader-location = 3)
    indices : uint16?      // Vertex indices (in case vertex data comes indexed)
    boneCount : int        // Number of bones (MAX: 256 bones)
    boneIndices : uint8?   // Vertex bone indices, up to 4 bones influence by vertex (skinning) (shader-location = 6)
    boneWeights : float?   // Vertex bone weight, up to 4 bones influence by vertex (skinning) (shader-location = 7)
    animVertices : float?  // Animated vertex positions (after bones transformations)
    animNormals : float?   // Animated normals (after bones transformations)
    vaoId : uint           // OpenGL Vertex Array Object id
    vboId : uint?          // OpenGL Vertex Buffer Objects id (default vertex data)

struct Shader    // Shader
    id : uint    // Shader program id
    locs : int?  // Shader locations array (RL_MAX_SHADER_LOCATIONS)

struct MaterialMap     // MaterialMap
    texture : Texture  // Material map texture
    color : Color      // Material map color
    value : float      // Material map value

struct Material          // Material, includes shader and maps
    shader : Shader      // Material shader
    maps : MaterialMap?  // Material maps array (MAX_MATERIAL_MAPS)
    params : float[4]    // Material generic parameters (if required)

struct Transform          // Transform, vertex transformation data
    translation : float3  // Translation
    rotation : float4     // Rotation
    scale : float3        // Scale

struct BoneInfo      // Bone, skeletal animation bone
    name : int8[32]  // Bone name
    parent : int     // Bone parent

struct ModelSkeleton       // Skeleton, animation bones hierarchy
    boneCount : uint       // Number of bones
    bones : BoneInfo?      // Bones information (skeleton)
    bindPose : Transform?  // Bones base transformation (Transform[])

struct Model                  // Model, meshes, materials and animation data
    transform : Matrix        // Local transform matrix
    meshCount : int           // Number of meshes
    materialCount : int       // Number of materials
    meshes : Mesh?            // Meshes array
    materials : Material?     // Materials array
    meshMaterial : int?       // Mesh material number
    skeleton : ModelSkeleton  // Skeleton for animation
    currentPose : Transform?  // Current animation pose (Transform[])
    boneMatrices : Matrix?    // Bones animated transformation matrices

struct ModelAnimation            // ModelAnimation, contains a full animation sequence
    name : int8[32]              // Animation name
    boneCount : uint             // Number of bones (per pose)
    keyframeCount : int          // Number of animation key frames
    keyframePoses : Transform??  // Animation sequence keyframe poses [keyframe][pose]

struct Ray              // Ray, ray for raycasting
    position : float3   // Ray position (origin)
    direction : float3  // Ray direction (normalized)

struct RayCollision   // RayCollision, ray hit information
    hit : bool        // Did the ray hit something?
    distance : float  // Distance to the nearest hit
    point : float3    // Point of the nearest hit
    normal : float3   // Surface normal of hit

struct BoundingBox  // BoundingBox
    min : float3    // Minimum vertex box-corner
    max : float3    // Maximum vertex box-corner

struct Wave            // Wave, audio wave data
    frameCount : uint  // Total number of frames (considering channels)
    sampleRate : uint  // Frequency (samples per second)
    sampleSize : uint  // Bit depth (bits per sample): 8, 16, 32 (24 not supported)
    channels : uint    // Number of channels (1-mono, 2-stereo, ...)
    data : void?       // Buffer data pointer

struct AudioStream                // AudioStream, custom audio stream
    buffer : rAudioBuffer?        // Pointer to internal data used by the audio system
    processor : rAudioProcessor?  // Pointer to internal data processor, useful for audio effects
    sampleRate : uint             // Frequency (samples per second)
    sampleSize : uint             // Bit depth (bits per sample): 8, 16, 32 (24 not supported)
    channels : uint               // Number of channels (1-mono, 2-stereo, ...)

struct Sound              // Sound
    stream : AudioStream  // Audio stream
    frameCount : uint     // Total number of frames (considering channels)

struct Music              // Music, audio stream, anything longer than ~10 seconds should be streamed
    stream : AudioStream  // Audio stream
    frameCount : uint     // Total number of frames (considering channels)
    looping : bool        // Music looping enable
    ctxType : int         // Type of music context (audio filetype)
    ctxData : void?       // Audio context data, depends on type

struct VrDeviceInfo                  // VrDeviceInfo, Head-Mounted-Display device parameters
    hResolution : int                // Horizontal resolution in pixels
    vResolution : int                // Vertical resolution in pixels
    hScreenSize : float              // Horizontal size in meters
    vScreenSize : float              // Vertical size in meters
    eyeToScreenDistance : float      // Distance between eye and display in meters
    lensSeparationDistance : float   // Lens separation distance in meters
    interpupillaryDistance : float   // IPD (distance between pupils) in meters
    lensDistortionValues : float[4]  // Lens distortion constant parameters
    chromaAbCorrection : float[4]    // Chromatic aberration correction parameters

struct VrStereoConfig             // VrStereoConfig, VR stereo rendering configuration for simulator
    projection : Matrix[2]        // VR projection matrices (per eye)
    viewOffset : Matrix[2]        // VR view offset matrices (per eye)
    leftLensCenter : float[2]     // VR left lens center
    rightLensCenter : float[2]    // VR right lens center
    leftScreenCenter : float[2]   // VR left screen center
    rightScreenCenter : float[2]  // VR right screen center
    scale : float[2]              // VR distortion scale
    scaleIn : float[2]            // VR distortion scale in

struct FilePathList  // File path list
    count : uint     // Filepaths entries count
    paths : string?  // Filepaths entries

struct AutomationEvent  // Automation event
    frame : uint        // Event frame
    _type : uint
    params : int[4]     // Event parameters (if required)

struct AutomationEventList     // Automation event list
    capacity : uint            // Events max entries (MAX_AUTOMATION_EVENTS)
    count : uint               // Events entries count
    events : AutomationEvent?  // Events entries

typedef Texture2D = Texture              // Texture2D, same as Texture
typedef TextureCubemap = Texture         // TextureCubemap, same as Texture
typedef Vector2 = float2

typedef Vector4 = float4
